regime_context: Detector shows a defensive/healthcare leadership structure: Big Pharma is the headline theme with the highest durability (0.84) and full breadth (1.0) among eligible themes, but it is crowded (z=1.5) and the gate is genuinely helpful on this market's history. Momentum rank is an attention lens only, and the top-ranked Memory/HBM theme is NOT eligible (trend gate off), so it does not qualify as a tradable leader.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the ineligible Memory/HBM leadership (rank 1, score 1.855) regains trend-gate eligibility (durability_bar currently 0.32) and rotates into a confirmed handoff from Big Pharma; I would retire this watch if Memory remains ineligible (eligible=false) for 15 consecutive trading days while Big Pharma holds rank 2 durability above 0.8.

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Big Pharma is the headline theme with trend-tag 'trend', the highest durability bar among eligible themes (0.84), full breadth (1.0), and rot.leader/challenger structure placing it as the challenger to ineligible Memory. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market (gate_helps true), so eligible + durable supports a modest directional lean. Crowding (z=1.5) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Big Pharma is crowded (z=1.5) and cross-sectional momentum has no forward return edge (rank-IC ~0); momentum rank reflects attention concentration, which can mark tops, not a buy list.

falsifier.text: PPH (Big Pharma proxy) lags S&P 500 by more than 4% over any 20-trading-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Health Care (Equal-Weight)
theses.thesis: XLV-tracking Health Care EW is eligible, trend-tagged 'trend', with broad breadth (0.883) and high durability (0.78). It sits adjacent to the Big Pharma leadership and shares the defensive healthcare tilt. Crowding (z=1.55) is elevated but only caps the lean; direction is conditionally constructive given the validated trend gate.
theses.dissent: Healthcare is already crowded and the rank-IC of cross-sectional momentum is near zero; the theme could stall or mean-revert despite trend health, with no validated return edge from the detector.

falsifier.text: XLV lags SPY by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Defensives
theses.thesis: Defensives (XLP/XLU proxies) are eligible, trend-tagged 'trend', with very broad breadth (0.944) and high durability (0.83). The market regime is dominated by healthcare/defensive leadership, and the validated absolute-trend gate favors staying with eligible durables. This is a direction-only lean with crowding (z=1.57) as a caution.
theses.dissent: This theme is unscorable (defensives has array proxy and scorable=false), so conviction is by definition low; crowding is high and there is no forward return edge in momentum rank.

falsifier.text: Equally-weighted XLP+XLU lags SPY by 5% before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
